finance.title: Tour payment follow-up
finance.description: Guests on this tour with a balance due or a receipt waiting.
finance.emptyOutstanding: No guests still owe for this tour.
finance.allSettled: All settled for this tour — no payment follow-ups right now.
finance.escapePaymentsHub: Open payments hub for this tour
finance.awaitingPaymentHint: Guests still owe — follow up when needed.
finance.guestListItemOpenHint: Select to review payment details and next actions.
finance.guestListItemSelectedHint: Currently open in the payment detail panel.
finance.detailDescription: Review this approved guest's payment state here and continue follow-up if needed.
finance.detailEmpty: Select a guest to review payment context and next actions here.
finance.detailSummaryDescription: Start with payment state and the remaining amount.
finance.detailRequirementBlockDescription: This section shows whether the follow-up amount comes from the registration balance or a payment plan.
finance.detailEvidenceDescription: If the guest uploaded a receipt from the portal, it appears here. Recorded payments are summarized here too.
finance.detailPortalReceiptHint: Guest-uploaded receipts and other receipt proof linked to this registration appear here.
finance.detailNoRecentReceipts: No pending receipts for this guest right now.
finance.detailNoRecentPayments: No recent payments to show yet.
finance.detailActionsDescription: Record received money first. Change the remaining amount only when it is wrong.
finance.detailRecommendationReviewReceiptTitle: Recommended next step: review proof first
finance.detailRecommendationReviewReceiptBody: This guest already has a receipt waiting. Review it before starting a new payment action.
finance.detailRecommendationScheduleTitle: Recommended next step: review the payment plan
finance.detailRecommendationScheduleBody: This guest still has an active payment plan. Review it before changing the amount or recording a new payment.
finance.detailRecommendationCollectTitle: Recommended next step: confirm the amount due, then collect
finance.detailRecommendationCollectBody: If the remaining amount is correct, record the amount that was actually received here.
finance.detailRecommendationSettledTitle: Recommended next step: no new payment action
finance.detailRecommendationSettledBody: This guest is already settled or does not need payment. Review history only if needed.
finance.detailPrimaryPaymentDescriptionUnpaid: Use this when finance is recording money that has already been received or confirmed from the admin side.
finance.detailPrimaryPaymentDescriptionPartial: Use this to record the next received amount while keeping any remaining balance visible for follow-up.
finance.detailInlineReviewDescription: Approve or reject proof without leaving workspace.
finance.detailReceiptSubmittedHint: Receipt submitted — review it in this panel.
finance.detailSecondaryActionTitle: Change the remaining amount only if it is wrong
finance.detailSecondaryActionDescription: Use this when the guest should owe a different amount. This does not record a received payment.
finance.workspacePaymentDescription: Use this when admin or finance already knows a payment amount was received and should count immediately.
finance.workspacePaymentSuggested: Suggested amount from the current balance: {amount}
finance.workspacePaymentHint: This admin-side entry counts as confirmed immediately. It does not require receipt upload, and any remaining balance stays visible for later follow-up.
finance.workspacePaymentRecordedHint: The balance and follow-up list refresh from this recorded amount.
finance.workspacePaymentRecordedSettled: This entry brings the case to fully settled.
finance.workspaceReceiptAdvancedDescription: Keep this path for exceptional cases. Normal guest proof should arrive through the portal and be reviewed from Receipts.
finance.workspaceReceiptAdvancedPaymentHint: Enter an existing payment ID when ops must attach proof to that payment. This is fallback tooling, not the normal record-payment flow.
finance.workspaceReceiptAdvancedUploadHint: Upload JPEG, PNG, or PDF only when the operator must submit proof on behalf of the guest.
finance.detailActionStateReviewTitle: This guest has a receipt waiting
finance.detailActionStateReviewDescription: To avoid duplicate actions, finish receipt review first and only come back here if the case still has an outstanding balance after review.
finance.detailActionStateReadOnlyTitle: No payment action is needed right now
finance.detailActionStateReadOnlyDescription: No new payment action is recommended right now. If needed, review payment history or open full details.
finance.detailActionStateAccessTitle: You cannot record actions in this section
finance.detailActionStateAccessDescription: You can review payment state and receipts here, but recording or changing payments is limited to admin/owner operators.
finance.detailExitNoticeNoPayment: {guest} no longer needs payment and was removed from this payment follow-up list.
finance.detailExitNoticeBalanceUpdated: Remaining amount for {guest} was updated. Refresh the list if you need to continue follow-up.
finance.detailOverrideDescription: This changes how much remains for this guest. Use the primary action to record money received.
finance.detailOverrideScheduleDescription: This registration already uses a payment plan. Adjust amounts there so the plan and remaining amount stay aligned.
finance.filtersAria: Filter guests needing follow-up by payment state
finance.focusMiss: That guest is not in this tour payment follow-up right now.
finance.degradedTitle: Some tour finance data is temporarily incomplete.
finance.degradedDescription: You can keep working here, but double-check the affected sections after refresh.
